name: io.github.najemwehbe/unreal-ai-connection
title: Unreal AI Connection
description: PREREQUISITE: install the Unreal AI Connection UE 5.7 plugin into your UE project and launch the editor (it binds 127.0.0.1:18888) before connecting — no registry can do this for you. This stdio bridge then exposes 105 Unreal Engine editor-automation tools (actors, levels, materials, Blueprints, sequencer, rendering, asset import, editor Python) to any MCP client.

environmentVariables.name: PYTHONUNBUFFERED
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 so the stdio bridge flushes JSON-RPC frames without buffering.
